name: calculator
description: Evaluate safe arithmetic expressions, including basic math functions.

input_schema.description: A math expression such as '12 * (3 + 4)' or 'sqrt(16)'.

name: unit_converter
description: Convert simple units such as cm to m, kg to g, and Celsius to Fahrenheit.

input_schema.description: A conversion request such as '10 cm to m'.

name: summarizer
description: Produce a short rule-based summary of input text.

examples.input: Skill retrieval finds tools. Skill calling executes tools.
examples.output: Summary: Skill retrieval finds tools. Skill calling executes tools.

name: translator_zh_en
description: Translate simple Chinese phrases into English with a rule-based placeholder.

input_schema.description: Chinese text to translate into English.

name: translator_en_zh
description: Translate simple English phrases into Chinese with a rule-based placeholder.

input_schema.description: English text to translate into Chinese.

examples.output: 你好 技能 检索 智能体

name: keyword_extractor
description: Extract frequent keywords from a text input.

input_schema.description: The text to extract keywords from.

examples.input: Skill retrieval and skill calling are important for agents.
examples.output: Keywords: skill, retrieval, calling, important, agents

name: text_rewriter
description: Rewrite text with light normalization and punctuation cleanup.

name: sentiment_analyzer
description: Classify simple sentiment as positive, negative, or neutral.

name: paper_qa
description: Placeholder paper question answering skill for later corpus integration.

examples.input: What is the contribution of this paper?
examples.output: Paper QA placeholder: no paper corpus is loaded yet.

name: python_executor
description: Execute small restricted Python snippets without file, system, or network access.
